bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Passes For Human
bonuses.text: A DN 3 Awareness (Int) Test is required to notice a Nexos is not Human.

abilities.name: Battlefield Analysis
abilities.text: Select an individual or Mob that the Nexos is aware of in 1km. All Threats with the GENESTEALER CULT Keyword gain +3 bonus dice to all tests targeting that individual or Mob until the start of the Nexos' next turn.

abilities.name: Strategic Coordination
abilities.text: A Threat with the GENESTEALER CULT Keyword within 1km that has fewer Wounds than the Nexos immediately takes a turn.

abilities.name: Unquestioning Loyalty
abilities.text: When a Threat with the GENESTEALER CULT and PSYKER Keywords within 6m of this Threat is targeted by a ranged attack, this Threat may interpose themself as a reaction and become the new target for the attack.
